decision: Exclude the unreferenced absolute BIOS data-area declaration file from the selected core build and retain it under research.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
The file declares absolute interrupt vector and BIOS data areas.
No include of dseg.inc was found in the retained BIOS, DOS, COMMAND and include source trees or the frozen selected reference dependency inventory.
Selected reference build reports do not list this file as an input.
limitations: Exclusion is limited to the selected three-component build and does not establish absence from other DOS or BIOS configurations.
